rebuild: properties.json was fully rebuilt from the audited Portfolio Statement (Datalab PAGE markers 210-218; carrying-amount columns are S$'000). The prior extraction is superseded: it had joined operating metrics AND rotated the audited market_valuation column by row position, which scrambled identity/metrics across several blocks while still summing to the correct totals. This rebuild sources every property's identity, market_valuation, tenure, acquisition date and country from the audited Portfolio Statement, then joins operating metrics (occupancy_rate, nla, gross_revenue, major_tenants) from the operating 'Property Profile' highlights table by matching audited valuation + tenure + lease-expiry, NOT by row order.

sources.audited_portfolio_statement: Datalab pages 210-218 (printed pages 208-216); carrying amount 2024 S$'000 rescaled x1000 to absolute SGD for market_valuation on every property, including foreign assets (the audited statement presents all carrying amounts in SGD).

join_methodology: market_valuation, land_tenure, tenure_raw, lease_term_years, lease_expiry_date, purchase_date (acquisition date) and country come from the audited Portfolio Statement (Tier C) — authoritative for identity and valuation.

occupancy_rate, nla (sqm, area_unit=sqm), gross_revenue (x1,000,000), major_tenants and purchase_price (x1,000,000) come from the operating Property Profile table, joined to each audited property by normalized property name where the operating row prints a name (95 of 112 rows).

The 17 operating rows printed as number-only in the parsed markdown (rows 40-56: Wetherill Park, Seven Hills, Winston Hills, Port Kembla, Brisbane Southern) were matched to the remaining audited properties by tenure type + audited valuation ($m) and, for right-of-use (footnote c) leaseholds where operating $m excludes the ROU asset, by lease-expiry date. Every match was verified: operating valuation $m equals audited carrying amount /1000 for all non-ROU rows.
Central Park is footnote (d) 50% effective interest; ownership=50, market_valuation is the audited consolidated carrying amount (324,488k), flagged full_consolidation_partial_ownership.

Footnote (c) leaseholds (Melbourne Airport, Wetherill Park, Port Kembla, Koperstraße Nuremberg) carry ROU assets in the audited carrying amount, so their audited market_valuation exceeds the operating Property Profile valuation; flagged carrying_amount_includes_rou.
